stage: Stage 2 — per-module coverage of the code-property graph
supersedes: the previous edition of this file, which was written in clone w-001 on 2026-08-31T16:11:52Z and described a graph of 605,687,359 bytes / sha256 ceefe60e58308ffcfc1d93f8ed6226bf25bac85678f1a54caf826340a25542a6 over 39 producing modules. That graph is not on this host and that clone’s scratch evidence is not reachable from here, so every verdict it carried was unverifiable in this checkout. This edition is measured against the graph that is on disk.
the_test: AAP 0.5.1, and nothing weaker. A module is COVERED only on injective evidence: a class present in that module’s primary artifact — its main unclassified, non-original-, non--tests JAR — and absent from every other module’s artifacts. A class shared with a same-module sibling still qualifies; a class shared with another module does not. Where no class is exclusive, the module-exclusive META-INF/maven/**/pom.properties node is accepted and named as the weaker witness. A shared package prefix is NEVER admissible evidence — every Spark module shares org.apache.spark, so a prefix test lets one module vouch for a dozen absent ones.
what_delivery_versus_coverage_mean: Delivery is proved by the staging manifest, which covers every archive without exception. Coverage asks a different question — whether a module’s own code reached the graph — and is what this file answers.

graph.written_by: provisioning, 2026-08-30T19:18:37Z — not by this run, whose frontend terminated at the flatgraph array-length ceiling over the complete staged input and wrote no accepted graph (harness/artifacts/logs/cpg-frontend.log, mechanism re-verified at three heaps - 8g, 64g and 128g - in cpg-ceiling-reverify.log)

measurements_joined.note: Both are files in this checkout; no scratch path outside it is cited.

totals.note: Every COVERED verdict rests on a named exclusive class that was then observed as a type declaration in the graph under its exact full name. No verdict rests on presence in the input, on a shared package prefix, or on any witness kind beyond the two the test admits.
totals.denominator_note: Two denominators are in play and neither substitutes for the other. 31 is the number of modules contributing an archive to THIS graph's input set, and 26 of 31 carry a COVERED verdict. 38 is the number of JAR-packaging projects the full reactor built, which is the denominator AAP 0.5.1 sets, and 26 of 38 carry a COVERED verdict. Every figure in this file states which of the two it is counted against.

aap_0_5_1_coverage_of_all_38_jar_produci.requirement: AAP 0.5.1 requires an injective per-module coverage verdict for every one of the 38 JAR-packaging projects the full-reactor build produced.
aap_0_5_1_coverage_of_all_38_jar_produci.verdict: NOT OBTAINABLE. A COVERED verdict exists for 26 of the 38 JAR-producing projects. For the remaining 12 no verdict of either admissible kind can be obtained from this graph, and none is asserted. This file therefore does not, and cannot, certify coverage for all 38.
aap_0_5_1_coverage_of_all_38_jar_produci.how_the_26_were_established: a class present in that project's primary artifact and absent from every other module's artifacts in the input set, then observed in the graph as a type declaration under its exact full name (harness/artifacts/logs/cpg-verify.log PHASE 2, the witness table; per-project rows in this file's entries[])
aap_0_5_1_coverage_of_all_38_jar_produci.why_the_shortfall_is_not_a_build_outcome: All 38 JAR-packaging projects DID produce their own main artifact. The reactor build succeeded with Maven exit code 0 over all 40 projects (harness/artifacts/logs/build-reactor.log; 'jar-packaging WITHOUT one : []'), and oss-scan-results/build-record.md owns that verdict at '38 of 38 with their own main artifact'. Not one of the twelve is missing because its project failed to build.
aap_0_5_1_coverage_of_all_38_jar_produci.attribution_of_the_shortfall: The shortfall is a consequence of the GRAPH'S PROVENANCE, not of the build. The graph every stage of this run loads was written by provisioning over a 62-archive staging tree that contains archives from only 31 of the 38 projects, and that vendors five further modules' classes into other modules' shaded archives. This run's own frontend invocation over the complete 191-archive input set failed in flatgraph's string-pool serialization and wrote no accepted graph (harness/artifacts/logs/cpg-frontend.log, mechanism re-verified at three heaps in harness/artifacts/logs/cpg-ceiling-reverify.log), so the all-JAR graph that would carry all 38 projects' bytecode does not exist. That unmet requirement is published as a divergence rather than repaired by trimming the input set or by weakening the witness test.
aap_0_5_1_coverage_of_all_38_jar_produci.what_is_never_done_here: No verdict is inferred from a shared package prefix, from presence in the input set, from another module's shaded archive, or from any graph other than the one named in this file's graph block. A project with no admissible witness is recorded as having no verdict, never as covered.
